criteria: India-based only; any seniority. Prior leadership titles are fine when current evidence establishes hands-on technical work.
Prioritize demonstrated ownership of RL/coding environments, tasks, verifiers/rewards, synthetic-data pipelines, model/agent evaluation or benchmarking, or post-training infrastructure.

Require concrete profile evidence of building, designing or owning relevant systems. Generic RAG/agent wrappers, annotation-only RLHF labels, cloud/MLOps or backend titles do not suffice by themselves.
Company brand, school prestige, follower count, source scores and similarity to a colleague do not establish fit. Explain actual work with an exact supporting profile quote.

Return fewer than ten, including zero, when evidence is insufficient; never pad with unselected profiles. Preserve explicit sourcing exclusions and keep existing candidates/examples out of a new prospect batch.
